Filitrios houses a giant toy store. One with a whole world of fun. It was the largest and the most popular, but every fun place has its own dark secrets. People went missing. Many toys remain inside.

> Moon Info

> Moon Exclusive Content

Filitrios Toy Store's Ambience

happyplace - special music that plays only on this map.

Teddy Bears

Filitrios's exterior and interior can have teddy bears with a pale head sown onto them. If the pale head has a blue right eye, the head will activate randomly when a player is nearby and look around the surrounding area in a clockwise rotation. If a player is seen during this time, the head will expand and an Arachnohead will spawn from the teddy bear.

Altar (Mysterious Object's Slot)

Filitrios's exterior also has an altar where a mysterious object can be placed. The altar is almost directly south from the back of the ship and slightly to the right before the bridge leading to the radio station. This mysterious object is a Brooding seed that can found in a hidden chamber on the exterior of Berunah. Placing the seed will cause a warning message to appear that says "A Cosmic Entity of unknown power has turned it's focus towards this planet".

This dramatically alters the terrain on the exterior, causes several tentacles to appear on the exterior that deal 20 damage per hit on contact, visually alters the interior, and causes the Assimilated Growth to almost immediately spawn in the interior when landing on the moon in the future. All these changes also apply to Centrus. This persists until players are fired unless seeds are also placed on the exteriors of Etern, Fission-C, Gloom, and Utril, in which case these changes become permanent on that save file.

> Progression

Unlocked By

Logging "Radio Message 3" found on the exterior of Trite.
Alternatively, inserting the Filitrios videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interiors of Adamance, Fission-C, Gloom, Motra, or Utril into the projector in Galetry.

Unlocks

Centrus: Interact with the computer in the radio station found on the exterior.
Crowd: "Teach the disloyal" videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.
Demetrica: Log "Radio Message 4" found on the exterior.
Hyve: Hyve videotape that is found within the breakable hive that has a 33% chance to spawn on the exterior.
Motra: Motra videotape that randomly spawns as scrap within the interior.

> Lore

Radio Message 4

Text ⁠
Hello everyone, you are listening to Across the Stars and I’d like to apologize for my absence in the past few days.

Times are tough.

It’s currently 2:23 PM and I’m sorry to announce that this will be my final broadcast.

My sources are dwindling and finding any good news has been like searching a needle in a haystack.
There’s just not much good out there anymore.
..It’s all terrible.

For those still out there. I’m telling you to leave.
Find the closest to you and go.
Go to the Domes.
There will be salvation on Demetrica.

I will be going too.

The Triton military has been growing in numbers and they’ll launch a system wide attack to conquer our side of the region.
And I don’t want anyone to experience the horrors of what that will bring.
So I’m telling you again, leave.
Run for the Domes.

We will be going dark.
This was Across the Stars.
Thank you.

I’ll see you there.

FILITRIOS TOY STORE CLOSED!
On the 253rd day of the year 2092, the Filitrios Toy Store was officially closed after several cases of missing children were resolved. The towns near the toy store have had several large vain shroud infestations before. There were several infested areas near the toy store which could easily have been rid by the Filitrios company. Unfortunately this has let to many so called 'Kidnapper Foxes' snatching children around the toys store and taking them back to their vain shroud hideouts to be killed. The toy store was therefor deemed unsafe and the company was sued for their neglect.

> Trivia

  • There is a Maneater and a Webley sitting next to each other in the toy store as an homage to Wesley and his girlfriend.



  • Behind the scenes:
    • Before Journeys update there were voiceline test and attempts before each videotape was finished. Here's a one of test voicelines of Voice of Filitrios. Voice that you can hear in Filitrios videotape.

  • Despite being in the Enemy Spawns (Interior) table, Lasso can not spawn without commands or additional modification. Wesley has previously stated Lasso was added to a spawn table because it was funny, which likely applies here too, but Wesley also created a Jester variant called Lasso Man and potentially added it to the table in the Obscurity update.
